title: Temple of the Forest
objective: Grow infrastructure as code: plan before you apply, fix risky configs and keep environments from drifting.
intro: Roots of old servers tangle the Forest Temple. Ganonix clicks through consoles and leaves drift behind. Clear five chambers to grow infrastructure from code.

trials.title: Planting the Grove
trials.prompt: Put the infrastructure-as-code workflow in order.
trials.hint: Always look at the plan before you apply it.
trials.success: Write, init, plan, review, apply: no surprises.

items.text: Review the plan in a pull request

trials.title: Thorns in the Config
trials.prompt: This Terraform would open the kingdom to attackers. Flag every risky line.
trials.hint: Look for public access and for a secret written in plain text.
trials.success: Public storage, an exposed database and a hard-coded password are all gone.

trials.title: Words of the Woods
trials.prompt: Match each infrastructure-as-code term to its meaning.
trials.hint: Drift is what happens when reality wanders away from the code.
trials.success: You speak the language of the forest.

pairs.right: Real infrastructure differs from the code
Running it again gives the same result

trials.title: The Container Glade
trials.prompt: Prepare the Dockerfile. Light the good practices and leave the risky ones dark.
trials.hint: Smaller, scanned, non-root images with no secrets baked in.
trials.success: A lean, scanned image that holds no secrets.
clues: Pin the base image to a version so builds are repeatable.
Containers should not run as root, and .env files must never be copied into an image.
Scan every image for known vulnerabilities, and use multi-stage builds to keep it small.

trials.title: Drift in the Grove
trials.prompt: Someone changed a security group by hand in the cloud console. The code no longer matches. What should happen?
trials.hint: The code is the source of truth. Changes go through pull requests.
trials.success: Code is the source of truth, and every change is reviewed.

options.why: Unreviewed drift becomes the next outage.

options.text: Capture the intent in code through a pull request, then re-apply.
Repeat the console edit in every environment.
options.why: That spreads the drift instead of removing it.
